svg.title: Discrete pressure model versus continuous intensity model
svg.desc: Same event sequence shown two ways. Discrete pressure jumps between fixed severity tiers and stays there. Continuous intensity rises and falls smoothly with accumulation and natural decay.
svg.text: same event sequence · two ways of representing drive

g.text: small or big signal — both jump one tier.
quiet periods do not bring pressure back down.
small signals nudge up · big ones spike higher.
quiet periods bring it back down naturally.
discrete model can't tell "minor disk warning" from "major distress" — both jump one tier.
discrete model also can't calm down without a manual reset — once degraded, stays degraded.
continuous model preserves both intensity gradation and natural decay.
